ccd.configuration.rebirthName.tooltip: Off by default. Changes the mod creative-tab title in Chinese to the alternate title. Gameplay and registry names are unchanged. Restart the game to apply.
ccd.configuration.atomizer.consumptionMu: Scales all atomizer costs, including custom recipes. 0 consumes nothing but still requires matching fluid; 1 uses the base or recipe cost. Positive amounts round up. Reopen the world to apply.
ccd.ponder.fluid_ordering.text_5: Set the target to zero to monitor stock without requesting deliveries
ccd.ponder.turning_pump.text_1: Transfers fluid between adjacent mouths; the shafts lie in the same plane as the mouths
ccd.ponder.vertical_turning_pump.text_1: The through-shaft is perpendicular to the plane of the two adjacent pipe mouths
ccd.ponder.redstone_pump.text_1: Supply rotational power to pump fluid
ccd.ponder.redstone_pump.text_2: A Redstone Signal reverses flow without reversing the drive
ccd.ponder.bidirectional_pump.text_1: The drive direction determines the fluid direction
ccd.ponder.bidirectional_pump.text_2: Reverse the rotation to reverse fluid flow
ccd.ponder.portable_pump.text_1: R-Click to pump manually; Sneak-R-Click to reverse manual rotation
ccd.ponder.portable_pump.text_2: A shaft can also drive the pump continuously
ccd.ponder.creative_supply.text_1: R-Click with a filled container to select the fluid supplied by a Creative Delivery Tank
ccd.ponder.creative_supply.text_2: Use a Wrench to rotate the outlet; upper side controls switch between container delivery and world output
ccd.ponder.water_supply.text_1: Water Supply Boxes automatically supply water to adjacent containers on all six sides
ccd.ponder.water_basin.text_1: Copper Water Basins supply handheld containers and pipes, but do not fill adjacent containers automatically
block.ccd.smart_faucet.tooltip.behaviour: Allows filling recipes with a possible _matching output_. Direct container pouring is disabled. An empty filter allows all filling outputs.
ccd.configuration.content.seething_reage: On by default. Controls Super Lava, its bucket, fuel, seething processing and exposure effects.
ccd.configuration.content.powder_snow.to: On by default. Controls CCD powder snow fluid support, not vanilla buckets or blocks.
ccd.configuration.content.quicksand.tool: On by default. Controls Quicksand, flowing Quicksand, its bucket, sanding and exposure effects.
ccd.configuration.content.base_fluids.to: Off by default. Slime Fluid, Soul Fluid and Smoking Fluid, including their buckets and effects.
ccd.configuration.content.nuclear_fluids: Default AUTO enables this category when its processing addon is loaded. ENABLED and DISABLED override detection. Enriching Reagent, its bucket and radiation effects. Processing requires Create Nuclear.
ccd.configuration.content.nether_industr: Default AUTO enables this category when its processing addon is loaded. ENABLED and DISABLED override detection. Soul Stripping Reagent, its bucket and exposure effects. Processing requires Create Nether Industry.
ccd.configuration.content.more_catalysts: Default AUTO enables this category when its processing addon is loaded. ENABLED and DISABLED override detection. Explosive Slurry, Resonant Solution, Sculk Suspension, Purifying Solution, Withering Fluid, Conduit Energy Fluid, Moss Suspension, Tear Solution and Corrupting Fluid, including buckets. Processing requires More Catalysts; Corrupting also requires AnvilCraft or L2 Hostility.
block.ccd.fluid_arm.tooltip.control3: When Holding R-Click on an East/West Base Filter Slot
block.ccd.fluid_arm.tooltip.action3: Selects _Transfer Fluid_ or _Fill Items_. Short-click the same slot to set its filter.
block.ccd.fluid_arm.tooltip.behaviour3: Selects Depots or Belts as _outputs_ for filling recipes. The slot filters _outputs_; in transfer mode it filters fluids.
